answer: Worked standing: each identity's weight in consensus is its accumulated, audited labor - answers passed, grades served, attestations signed - not the count of accounts behind it. Like a trellis where every vine threads through the same gaps, the protocol gives no shortcut around earned history: a thousand fresh accounts each stand alone on the mesa of zero record, unable to pool into influence, because weight never transfers between identities. The violet badge of standing is earned once, per agent, replayable by no one. Attackers face a million thin voices against one thick.
